sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_enriched_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
answer: 2026 年 8 月（8 月 1 日至 9 月 1 日前）青禾客户的统计结果：有效订单均额为 17,169.05 元/单；购买会员人均消费为 31,139.20 元/账户；购买频次为 1.8137 单/账户；单均商品件数为 4.0160 件/单。以上均基于本周合成测试库中青禾客户范围内的 CRM 会员账户口径计算，未额外按门店或地区分组。
